{{Quote|It's a ''trap''&mdash;the Rebels have some kind of ''secret army'' down here!|A [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]], facing the reactivated [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]|<ref name="REP" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''skirmish''' took place in a [[Unidentified warehouse (deserted moon)|warehouse]] located on a [[Unidentified deserted moon|deserted moon]]. It involved a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], as well as his [[Pilot/Legends|co-pilot]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. Due to a contingent of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] that had stood dormant in the warehouse since the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Solo and Chewbacca were able to defeat the Empire and left the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] aboard their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Let's just take what we need to ''patch up'' the ''Falcon''. No one's going to miss a few circuits.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]|<ref name="REP" />}}
While transporting supplies for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] on their [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Pilot/Legends|co-pilot]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] tried to shake off [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After losing their main [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] under enemy fire, the rebels were forced to land on a nearby [[Unidentified deserted moon|abandoned moon]] in order to make repairs. Once on the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] surface, Solo and Chewbacca discovered a [[Unidentified warehouse (deserted moon)|warehouse]] that contained a contingent of [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]-era [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], along with their [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transports]]. The two successfully scavenged the parts they needed to repair the ''Falcon''{{'s}} burnt out [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]].<ref name="REP" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|These clones didn't last long!''"<br />"''And they reek of sweat too! What a design flaw!|Two [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s, upon shooting the last standing [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]]|<ref name="REP" />}}
Before the rebels could leave the deserted moon with their repaired vessel, a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of six Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] entered the warehouse aboard a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]]. Although outnumbered, Solo and Chewbacca found a way to overcome the Imperials by re-activating a number of the battle droids they had found earlier. When the droids saw the stormtroopers, they mistook those [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|armored]] soldiers for their predecessors, the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], against which they had fought the Clone Wars. While the Imperials were trying to fend off their mechanical opponents, Solo and Chewbacca managed to get back into their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''Millennium Falcon'', and left the moon for good.<ref name="REP" />
